Comprehensive Business Tax Preparation
Experience a seamless tax season, every time with our tax services for business. We’ll prepare and file both your business and personal tax returns together.
Quarterly Tax Planning & Estimates

No more guessing games. Our proactive tax planning and estimates keep you ahead of tax bills, so there are no surprises at year-end. Do you need business tax prep services? We’re here when you need us.
Acuity offers business tax preparation services for entrepreneurs and small businesses alike.

Pricing depends on your business structure, filing requirements, and the level of tax planning needed. Most business returns start at $3,300, and we’ll provide a custom quote during your initial consultation. No surprise bills or added costs. Quarterly planning and other services are bundled within your personalized quote based on your stage and needs.

We use trusted professional tax software like ProConnect Tax Online and CCH Axcess, depending on the return type and complexity. We also integrate with your existing bookkeeping tools like QuickBooks Online and Xero to ensure accuracy and efficiency.

We start by gathering your documents and syncing with your bookkeeping system, whether that’s with Acuity, in-house, or another outsourced bookkeeper. Your dedicated tax manager prepares the return, runs compliance checks, and identifies deductions or credits. Once complete, you review and e-sign – simple, secure, and stress-free.
Are there tax planning services offered in addition to the preparation?

Yes. We offer quarterly tax planning and estimates so you’re never caught off guard by a surprise bill. You can also schedule one-on-one sessions with your dedicated tax expert to discuss strategy, timing, and big decisions throughout the year.

We’ll guide you through exactly what we need, but generally that includes prior year returns, current year financials, payroll records, 1099s, and any documents related to credits or deductions. You’ll receive a custom checklist based on your business entity.
